description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceReviewSaveController class within the OrangeHRM project. It extends AbstractVueController and manages pre-render logic for performance review creation or editing by setting appropriate Vue components and properties based on request attributes.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewSaveController
classes.description: Controller handling the save operation for performance reviews, setting Vue components for editing or adding reviews based on request data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component before rendering, choosing between 'edit-review' and 'add-review' based on whether an 'id' is provided in the request attributes.
